settings.name: attestation_issuer
settings.description: The iss of the attestations minted for this client; a client without it is not an attestation client

when_wrong.detail: Missing: the client is unknown to the attester. PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about (F-0041), so each is declared server-side

settings.name: attestation_issued_ttl
settings.description: How long a minted attestation lives, in seconds, and never past the evidence; at most OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_ISSUED_TTL, and never above 64800 (the AI Agent Profile's 18-hour ceiling)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 1 to 64800, or above OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_ISSUED_TTL in production: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client, naming the property, never its value) and the attester skips the client with a warning. Above the cap in development: clamped to the cap with a warning

settings.name: attestation_spiffe_bundle
settings.description: The trust bundle, an inline JWK Set, that verifies this client's evidence; this or attestation_bundle_url is required for every evidence type but a wallet instance attestation

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON object, not a JWK Set, or one with no keys: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client, naming the property) and the attester skips the client with a warning

settings.name: attestation_bundle_url
settings.description: Where the trust bundle is fetched from (and cached) at issuance, in place of attestation_spiffe_bundle; the fetch is held to the outbound fetch rules, with no operator exemption

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client, naming the property) and the attester skips the client with a warning - from 0.6.0; before, it failed at the fetch. Unreachable with nothing cached: that client's issuance fails

settings.name: attestation_entitlement
settings.description: The client's RFC 9396 authorization_details ceiling, a JSON array held to the RAR models when the configuration is parsed; an instance's own ceiling must sit within it

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON array, or one the models refuse: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning

settings.name: attestation_signing_key_ref
settings.description: The OpenBao transit key this client's attestations are signed with; exactly one of this and attestation_signing_jwk

when_wrong.detail: Both or neither set: invalid_client at issuance. Set with no OpenBao configured: server_error

settings.name: attestation_signing_jwk
settings.description: The private key this client's attestations are signed with, as an inline JWK; exactly one of this and attestation_signing_key_ref

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON object: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning. Not a usable key: invalid_client at issuance

settings.name: attestation_instances
settings.description: The client's instance bindings, a JSON array of objects: each a subject (spiffe_id, or a wallet instance's id), an optional entitlement ceiling within the client's, and metadata

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON array of objects, or a ceiling the models refuse: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning

settings.name: attestation_trust_domain
settings.description: The trust domain the client's evidence must belong to: pinned for SPIFFE and wallet evidence when set, and required for the cloud evidence types, whose SPIFFE path it anchors

when_wrong.detail: Missing for a cloud evidence type: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning

settings.name: attestation_evidence
settings.description: The evidence type the client's instances present

when_wrong.detail: Not one of the types, in any case (before 0.6.0 only the lower-case spelling was taken): the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning

settings.name: attestation_evidence_issuer
settings.description: The iss the client's cloud evidence must carry (a cluster's or an account's issuer); unset, any issuer the trust bundle verifies

when_wrong.detail: Read as given; evidence from another issuer is refused at issuance

settings.name: attestation_asserted_context_resolver
settings.description: The asserted-context resolver (entra-directory) whose ceiling narrows this client's evidenced one when a request carries asserted_context - but the attester's PingFederate client store reads only the other eleven names, so on a PingFederate client it has no effect (F-0230)

when_wrong.detail: Ignored on a PingFederate client (F-0230): the request's asserted_context is ignored and the evidenced ceiling applies unnarrowed
